name: ttsim-perf
platform_scope: cycle-approximate Tensix and Rocket timing (incl. cold first-iteration costs); L1-interleaved NoC transfers ARE timed (8.5% mean error), DRAM transfers are NOT. Times are simulator cycles reported as ns (1 cycle = 1 ns by convention), not silicon.

calibration.holdout: src B (DRAM/borrowed); L1 terms fitted on the L1 runs of B, D, E
calibration.method: qperf.calibration.fit: coordinate descent, mean squared log(pred/meas)

clock.note: 1 cycle reported as 1 ns so that ns == cycles; not a hardware clock

assumptions: costs are simulator cycles from the device profiler KERNEL zones (per-cluster span)
DM kernels start ~4 us after the first Neo kernel on this simulator (DFB setup); prologue dominates small ops
L1-interleaved (placement l1) transfers on this simulator: cluster-wide NoC barriers and a shared completion queue, fitted to 9.0% mean error (up to 32% at dm_batch=1); DRAM transfers are untimed
